blocks.text:
Can we agree
the chaos is by design
Melancholy
with no focus, no bottom line
I looked around my life and saw it all in place
So why this hollow feeling I can't seem to erase

I'd decide to get mad at myself
Put the sadness on a shelf
But yesterday I let it stay
Said it's appropriate today

Staccato, again
Pauses gone
Sad is catalytic
Mad is raw
Let me sit, let me feel
Before the gears fall
Staccato, again
Pauses gone

Small-screen whispers, pundit pageantry
tip my grief toward a target I can't see
Skip the lesson,
go straight to the reaction
Donated our discernment
for the speed of satisfaction

The tools succumb
Are they also dumb?
Speed without comprehension
Critique without recognition

Staccato, again
Pauses gone
Sad is catalytic
Mad is raw
Let me sit, let me feel
Before the gears fall
Staccato, again
Pauses gone

Happy is the weather, fleeting, not engineered
Joy is just the other side of everything I've feared
Try to hold just tails, the coin is in your hand
It's all there, connected. Just let it land

I wish for a better tomorrow
But today sad is okay
